items.title: Vertiv Holdings Co (VRT) Deepens AI Data Center Liquid Cooling Push
items.summary: Vertiv Holdings Co (NYSE:VRT) announced a new partnership with Solenis focused on data center liquid cooling for AI workloads. The collaboration combines Vertiv's cooling systems and predictive maintenance tools with Solenis' fluid chemistry and monitoring expertise. The joint offering is aimed at improving reliability, risk management, and long-term efficiency in liquid cooled AI data centers.
